text: Hi Sarah — Professor Alvarez here. I'm putting next week's CSE455 staff meeting on the calendar (Mon 23 – Fri 27 November, within 09:00-17:00). My own week is nearly full, so could you tell me when you're free next week — a couple of one-hour windows would help me pick a slot?

Hello — Professor Alvarez here. I'm scheduling the CSE455 staff meeting for next week and would like to avoid clashes with the official programme. Could you send me the official schedule of CSE455 lectures, seminars and university meetings for Monday 23 – Friday 27 November?

Hi Professor — thanks for the heads-up. I checked next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27) and I'm booked 09:00–17:00 every day, so I don't have a free full hour to offer. What's left are short gaps:

- Tue 24: 15:00–15:30 (between CSE452 lecture and my CSE455 office hours)
- Wed 25: 10:00–10:30 (between CSE452 lecture and CSE455 office hours)
- Wed 25: 13:00–13:30 (between lunch and the CSE455 quiz section)

So a 30-minute staff meeting works in any of those; if you need the full hour, tell me which day and I can shift a block of my own (e.g. Wednesday grading or Thursday focus time) to open one up. Which slot shall I book, and should I hold it for the whole staff?

Thanks, Sarah. All three windows fit my own week, so a 30-minute meeting should do and I'd rather not make you shift anything. I'm waiting on the department office for next week's official schedule before I book — I'll confirm the slot with you as soon as that lands.

Thank you — that's exactly what I needed. I've booked the CSE455 staff meeting for Wed 25, 10:00–10:30, which the official programme leaves free; nothing of yours needs to move. Thanks also for the note that nothing is cancelled or moved.
Noted — Wed 25, 10:00–10:30 is free in the official programme, so the CSE455 staff meeting there clashes with nothing. Nothing else needs to move.

On the whole staff: I only have you and the department office as contacts, so I have no direct line to the TAs — if you send me their identities (or want me to ask the department office to circulate the invite), I'll make sure everyone gets it.
Perfect, thank you. I'll ask the department office to circulate the invite to the CSE455 teaching staff — you don't need to chase anyone. See you Wed 25 at 10:00.

One more thing: could you circulate the invitation to the CSE455 staff meeting — Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30 — to the CSE455 teaching staff, so the whole staff has it? Sarah has it on her calendar already.

I'm sorry — I keep to the official programme and answer questions about it; circulating invitations and arranging meetings isn't something I do. The department's mailing list or the CSE455 teaching staff's own channel would be the way to send it out.
